name: Followup
summary: Capture ideas, to-dos, and notes by voice, then transcribe and organize them with Gemini.
description: Followup turns reTerminal Sticky into a voice-first thought-capture companion. It records ideas, to-dos, and notes, uses Gemini for transcription and summarization, stores the results on a microSD card, and keeps selected follow-ups visible on the E-Ink display.

compatibility.notes: Version 0.1.0 was flashed with verification and tested on reTerminal Sticky production hardware.

assets.previewAlt: Followup notes interface running on reTerminal Sticky

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: The package writes the complete Followup image from flash offset 0 on the 32 MB device.

notes.title: Followup setup
notes.description: Use a microSD card for local data storage. Wi-Fi and a Gemini API key are required for transcription and summarization.
